differences: Missing scores are kept as empty cells: 3 single trials in the acquisition blocks and all 19 trials of one participant in R24. The paper's linear-mixed-model estimates differ slightly from raw group means where scores are missing (for example EX90 at R24: 72.45 here against 72.63 in the paper), so only means that match to the printed two decimals are used as checks.
